mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH),0) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='imp_eng_installation' AND column_name='install_location'

SELECT d.id,d.sn,requests.requested_sn FROM ast_device d JOIN (
VALUES ROW(#{sn})
SELECT CONVERT(NULL USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS requested_sn WHERE 1=0
) requests(requested_sn) ON d.sn=CONVERT(requests.requested_sn USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE d.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT `id`,`project_id`,`code`,`equipment_id`,`install_location`,`address_id`,`address_version`,`site_id`,`site_version`,`site_location_id`,`site_location_version`,`location_resolution_status`,`address_snapshot`,`location_snapshot`,`effective_from`,`effective_to`,`current_equipment_id`,`install_time`,`installer_user_id`,`environment_check`,`spec_check`,`photo_url`,`result`,`status`,`remark`,`version`,`creator`,`create_time`,`updater`,`update_time`,`deleted`,`tenant_id` FROM imp_eng_installation WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND (1=0 OR project_id IN #{id}OR equipment_id IN #{id}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{query.limit} FOR UPDATE
